<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import {
  CopilotChat,
  CopilotChatConfigurationProvider,
  CopilotThreadsDrawer,
} from "@copilotkit/vue/v2";

const threadId = ref<string>(crypto.randomUUID());
const selectThread = (id: string) => {
  threadId.value = id;
};
const startNewConversation = () => {
  threadId.value = crypto.randomUUID();
};
</script>

<template>
  <CopilotChatConfigurationProvider :thread-id="threadId">
    <CopilotThreadsDrawer
      :on-thread-select="selectThread"
      :on-new-thread="startNewConversation"
    />
    <button type="button" @click="startNewConversation">
      New conversation
    </button>
    <CopilotChat />
  </CopilotChatConfigurationProvider>
</template>

import { useAgent, useCopilotKit } from "@copilotkit/vue/v2";

const { agent } = useAgent({ agentId: "sales" });
const { copilotkit } = useCopilotKit();

async function run() {
  const current = agent.value;
  if (!current || current.isRunning) return;

  current.addMessage({
    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
    role: "user",
    content: "Summarize the latest sales data",
  });

  try {
    await copilotkit.value.runAgent({ agent: toRaw(current) });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("CopilotKit runAgent failed:", error);
  }
}

function stop() {
  const current = agent.value;
  if (!current) return;
  copilotkit.value.stopAgent({ agent: toRaw(current) });
}
</script>

<template>
  <button :disabled="agent?.isRunning" @click="run">Run agent</button>
  <button :disabled="!agent?.isRunning" @click="stop">Stop</button>
</template>

function setTone(tone: string) {

  const previous = (current.state ?? {}) as WorkspaceState;
  current.setState({
    ...previous,
    preferences: { ...previous.preferences, tone },

}

framework-quickstart.code:
import os

from ag_ui_strands import StrandsAgent, create_strands_app
from strands import Agent
from strands.models.openai import OpenAIModel

# Setup your Strands agent
api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
model = OpenAIModel(
    client_args={"api_key": api_key},
    model_id="gpt-6-luna",
)

agent = Agent(
    model=model,
    system_prompt="You are a helpful AI assistant.",
)

# Wrap with AG-UI integration
agui_agent = StrandsAgent(
    agent=agent,
    name="strands_agent",
)

# Create the FastAPI app
app = create_strands_app(agui_agent, "/")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn

    uvicorn.run("main:app", host="0.0.0.0", port=8000, reload=True)
